Hi Michael / Alice,

Great speaking with you yesterday — excited about GreenLeaf's interest in listing via AWS Private Offers. Based on your projected first-year ARR and the co-sell commitment, we believe a custom volume-tier (beyond our published marketplace bands) will make the economics work for GreenLeaf's procurement.

Request: can we start a short review for a volume-threshold waiver that would enable the following one-time concession for the private offer: 25% off list for the first 12 months on committed spend >= $1.2M (annualized)? This is outside our standard marketplace private-offer template and requires Deal Desk / Marketplace approval.

Why this is justified:
- GreenLeaf is committing to a multi-year commercial and co-sell motion with our strategic cloud partner.
- The deal includes a Dedicated deployment option (reserved capacity), which improves our unit economics.
- Fast procurement timeline: they asked for final pricing and PO by the end of November.
